# ADAM v0.42 Living Recreation Architecture

```text
EXTERNAL EVIDENCE / SENSOR / APPLICATION / MEDIA
                         │
                         ▼
              EXACT ATOMIC CHEMISTRY
       content-defined atoms + ordered recipes
                         │
               evidence/derivation bonds
                         ▼
              SEMANTIC ATOMIC CHEMISTRY
      typed atoms + recursive compounds + bonds
                         │
         laws / authority / security / time
                         ▼
                LIVING UNIVERSE ROOT
                         │
        ┌────────────────┼────────────────┐
        ▼                ▼                ▼
  DEMAND ROUTER    NOVELTY PROTOCOL   COGNITION
 trained choice    missing closure     prediction
        │                │                │
        └────────────────┼────────────────┘
                         ▼
               RECREATION / SPAWN BUS
        documents │ media │ APIs │ IoT │ robotics
                         │
                         ▼
              DISPOSABLE MATERIALIZATION
```

## Core runtime objects

### Atom

A deterministic content-addressed unit. Exact chunks, semantic scalars, keys, codecs, claims, entities and capabilities are atoms.

### Compound

A recursive ordered construction. Exact objects, maps, sequences, schemas, learned motifs and recreation recipes are compounds. A compound at one scale may be referenced as a reusable unit at the next.

### Bond

A typed, directional, contextual and historical relationship. Examples include `EXACTLY_RECREATED_FROM`, `HAS_SEMANTIC_STRUCTURE`, `HAS_RECREATION_RECIPE`, `EVIDENCED_BY`, and domain relationships.

### Recreation recipe

The authoritative recipe links an artifact identity to:

- exact object root;
- semantic structure root;
- codec identity;
- reconstruction metadata and proof.

### Spawn demand

A demand states the artifact, application, target representation, purpose, device class, latency class and optional parameters. It produces a non-authoritative receipt and optional temporary file.

## Recreation path

```text
request
  → authorize closure
  → locate recipe
  → hydrate missing atoms/compounds
  → reconstruct exact or semantic state
  → choose validated constructor
  → create requested form
  → issue non-authoritative receipt
  → consume
  → release materialization
```

## Unknown future media

An unfamiliar format is still exactly atomized and reconstructable. Meaningful transformation is withheld until a suitable codec or learned perception model exists. This gives ADAM universal exact digital recreation without pretending to have universal semantic understanding.

## Distributed novelty

Nodes compare global identities under a dictionary root and epoch. The sender transfers only atoms, compounds and bonds absent from the destination. The destination verifies the entire closure and exact reconstruction before accepting the artifact recipe.

## Embodiment

Robots and IoT devices expose a capability surface containing sensors, actuators, actions, limits, permissions, communication channels and resource constraints. ADAM constructs bounded command envelopes only after policy validation. Physical adapters remain responsible for independent authentication and enforcement.
